behavior: Outer-refusal receipts bind any retained invalid child output to its canonical path and SHA-256 and reread those bytes before resume accounting.
A null retained-output binding remains valid only while the exact expected child output is absent, or while the parent settlement is explicitly non-quiescent.

Parent settlements use an exact schema. Quiescent true requires quiescenceScope process-group-and-observed-descendants. Quiescent false permits the field to be absent or exactly that value and rejects any other value.
The actual quiescent:false runOwnedProcess shape is retained as an outer refusal, does not hash unsettled output, blocks further dispatch, and blocks resume.
